Hi Ethan / Aisha —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. Really appreciated how your infra team partnered with ours to validate latency and cost profiles under realistic traffic. Attached is a concise slide (BC_POC_metrics_slide.pdf) with the operational metrics we captured during the three-week test. TL;DR highlights: 

- Median tail latency (p95) improved from ~420ms to ~260ms for your core inference path (small payloads).
- Peak throughput per GPU increased ~3x with Redwood's continuous batching and KV cache warmup.
- Estimated inference cost per 1M tokens dropped ~65% using the suggested quantized variant + caching policy.

Those figures were what your engineering team observed during the peak day on July 10 — we included the anonymized request mix and sequence-length distribution on slide 3.

If Brightcart is comfortable, we'd love to add a short public-facing note about the pilot results — either a one-line quote for a case snippet or a 30-second audio soundbite for a short video. We won't publish anything without your sign-off. Suggested asks: 

1) One-sentence quote (30–40 words) we can include in a blog post and sales one-pager.
2) Optional: 30-second audio clip (phone recording or MP3) we can splice into a short customer highlight.

Would either work? If you prefer a quick call to draft the line together, happy to set a 10-minute slot.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
